description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by IT Ops/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You’ll Do

We are seeking a Senior Engineer to be the technical expert on our Business Applications team. The Business Applications (BizApps) team is the operational backbone for organizational collaboration, system connectivity, and process automation at Horizon3. We partner with every department to provide the platforms, guardrails, and integrations that eliminate manual toil safely and efficiently. We own and administer Jira, Jira Service Management (JSM), Confluence, Rovo, Loom, Glean, and our citizen development platform, Workato. We hold ourselves to least-privilege access, data privacy, and auditable data flows in everything we build.

In this role, you will partner with business teams to turn pain points into working solutions. You will gather requirements with empathy, apply human-centered, API-first, and secure-by-design principles, select the best-fit tooling from our stack (the Atlassian suite, Workato, custom AWS automation tooling, and our AI platforms), and own each solution end to end, from discovery through production support.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager, Business Applications. You will work alongside our IT Admins and AI Admins as their technical escalation point and mentor.

This role will be responsible for:

  • Lead discovery with stakeholders across the company, using interviews and process walkthroughs to define the problem, who is affected, and how success will be measured

  • Translate pain points into scoped problem statements and recommend the best-fit approach (native feature, Workato, or custom automation), explaining tradeoffs in speed, maintainability, and risk

  • Design solutions using human-centered, API-first, event-driven, and secure-by-design principles, and document architecture decisions so others can support and extend them

  • Own solutions end to end: design, build, test, release, monitor, support, and retire

  • Build and maintain Workato recipes and connectors with resilient error handling, end-to-end monitoring, and auditable data flows

  • Build custom automation tooling and AWS middleware where native features and Workato cannot meet the requirement

  • Design and evolve complex workflows, custom fields, automations, and service management configurations in Jira, JSM, and Confluence beyond day-to-day administration

  • Architect and evolve our governed citizen development platform, Workato, including standardized frameworks, templates, reusable connectors, service accounts, and sandboxes, and review team-built automations against established guardrails

  • Enforce least-privilege access in every solution through role-based access control (RBAC), appropriate read/write scopes, and service accounts in place of individual credentials, partnering with Security and IT Engineering

  • Serve as the technical escalation point for IT Admins and AI Admins, review their work, and mentor them toward engineering-level scope

  • Partner with AI Admins and the Senior Manager to apply Glean, Rovo, Claude, Gemini, and Bedrock capabilities to complex business automation needs

  • Write runbooks, design documents, and handoff materials that allow Admins to support what you build

  • Report on delivery velocity, integration reliability, and adoption to the Senior Manager and stakeholders

  • Demonstrate a commitment to integrity, process improvement, and customer satisfaction

What You’ll Bring

  • Must have demonstrated experience owning solutions from requirements gathering through production support, leading complex, high-impact projects with little to no supervision

  • Must have hands-on experience building and maintaining integrations on an iPaaS platform (Workato strongly preferred), including error handling, monitoring, and secure credential handling

  • Must have working knowledge of APIs, webhooks, data models, and REST and event-driven integration patterns, and the ability to write custom code or scripts where iPaaS cannot meet the requirement

  • Must have hands-on experience engineering workflows, custom fields, and automations in Jira, JSM, and Confluence, or comparable work management and ITSM platforms

  • Must have experience gathering requirements from non-technical teams and turning them into design documents and testable acceptance criteria

  • Must have an understanding of RBAC, least-privilege access, service account practices, and data privacy as they apply to integrations and automations

  • Must have experience mentoring more junior engineers or administrators through design guidance and work review

  • Must be able to explain design decisions and tradeoffs clearly in writing to both technical and non-technical audiences

Minimum Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 5+ years of experience in IT, business systems engineering, integration, or automation engineering

  • 3+ years of experience building and supporting production integrations or automations

  • Experience supporting a distributed or remote-first workforce

Required Tech Stack Experience

  • Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence (Atlassian suite) or comparable work management and ITSM platforms

  • Workato or a similar iPaaS platform

  • APIs, webhooks, and REST and event-driven integration patterns

  • Scripting or programming language for custom automation (Python, JavaScript, Ruby)

  • Cloud services for custom middleware, such as AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge) or similar

What Sets You Apart?

  • You have built governed self-service or citizen development programs where business teams automate safely within guardrails

  • You have designed JSM service catalogs, request types, and SLAs that measurably improved response and resolution times

  • You have built agents, Projects, Skills, or Gems on Glean, Rovo, Claude, Gemini, or AWS Bedrock for real business use cases, not just experimentation

  • You have built audit-ready integrations in an environment subject to SOC 2 or similar compliance requirements

  • You have a track record of developing administrators or junior engineers into higher-scope roles

  • Relevant certifications such as Atlassian, Workato, AWS, or similar

  • Experience in high-growth SaaS or cybersecurity companies

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $150,000 - $200,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
